mechanism: Valproic acid depletes coenzyme Q10 levels through inhibition of mevalonate pathway enzyme HMG-CoA reductase, potentially reducing cellular energy production and antioxidant defenses.
action: Monitor for signs of muscle weakness, fatigue, or myopathy; consider coenzyme Q10 supplementation (100-200 mg daily) in patients on chronic valproic acid therapy, particularly those with mitochondrial concerns.
